# Correlations
## Import Libraries
```{r Import Libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(Hmisc)
library(corrplot)
library(ggcorrplot)
source("Code/Functions/CorrelationFunction.R")
options(scipen = 999)
```
## Import Data
```{r import data}
# use HachYSI-CorrelationMatrix-Rvalues.csv to import dataframe of correlation matrix made in 01-HachYSI-Correlations.Rmd
cormat_RValues <- read_csv("Data/Clean/HachYSI/01_Correlations/HachYSI-CorrelationMatrix-Rvalues.csv")

# use HachYSI-CorrelationMatrix-Pvalues.csv to import dataframe of correlation matrix made in 01-HachYSI-Correlations.Rmd
cormat_PValues <-  read_csv("Data/Clean/HachYSI/01_Correlations/HachYSI-CorrelationMatrix-Pvalues.csv")
```
## Data Formatting
```{r format data}
# change row names of dataframes to be the column names
row_names <- colnames(cormat_PValues)
rownames(cormat_PValues) <- row_names
rownames(cormat_RValues) <- row_names

# turn both dataframes into matrices
cormat_RValues <- as.matrix(cormat_RValues)
cormat_PValues <- as.matrix(cormat_PValues)

# turn NAs into insignificant values
cormat_PValues[is.na(cormat_PValues)] <- 1.00 
cormat_RValues[is.na(cormat_RValues)] <- 0.00

```

```{r plots}
# Correlogram
corrPlot_total <- ggcorrplot(cormat_RValues, 
                       outline.color = "white", 
                       ggtheme = ggplot2::theme_gray(), 
                       colors = c("#6D9EC1", "white", "#E46726"), 
                       lab = TRUE,
                       title = "Biosphere 2 Ocean Hach and YSI Water Quality Correlations")
# Save Plot
ggsave(filename = "HachYSI-Correlations-Correlogram.pdf", 
       plot = corrPlot_total,
       path = "Figures/HachYSI/01_Correlations",
       width = 15, height = 15)


# Correlogram with Significance
corrPlot_signif <- ggcorrplot(cormat_RValues, 
                              p.mat = cormat_PValues,
                              outline.color = "white", 
                              ggtheme = ggplot2::theme_gray(), 
                              colors = c("#6D9EC1", "white", "#E46726"), 
                              lab = TRUE,
                              insig = "blank", 
                              title = "Biosphere 2 Ocean Hach and YSI Water Quality Correlations\n
                              Significant Correlations Shown (PValue > 0.05)")
# Save Plot
ggsave(filename = "HachYSI-Correlations-Correlogram-Significant.pdf", 
       plot = corrPlot_signif,
       path = "Figures/HachYSI/01_Correlations",
       width = 15, height = 15)


```
